attorneys: Mr. James F. Reilly for petitioner. Messrs. Leo A. Rover, U. S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, and Neil Burkinshaw, Assistant U. S. Attorney, for the United States.

opinions.text: The motion for leave to proceed further herein in forma pauperis is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari is also granted, limited to the question raised by the exception to the ruling of the trial court on the examination on voir dire of prospective jurors.
